It uses the sby strategy with smtbmc. No equivalence result exists yet: the platform runs equivalence.run over this setup, and only that run can show whether the two versions are equivalent.", "artifacts": [{"kind": "equivalence_report", "title": "Equivalence report: updown_counter.v (gold) vs updown_counter_refactor.v (gate)", "summary": "This report serves [requirement:req-8077a859ef]: an equivalence check of the refactor of the existing up/down counter. Gold is [artifact:prj-f735fc7be7.design-under-test.a1] (updown_counter.v, adder-based step). Gate is [artifact:prj-f735fc7be7.design-under-test.a2] (updown_counter_refactor.v, toggle-chain step with no adder). Both declare module updown_counter with the same ports (clk, rst, load, din[3:0], en, up, q[3:0], carry, borrow) and the same state register q, so default name matching should pair q, carry and borrow without [match] rules. The setup reads each file with read_verilog and elaborates both with prep -top updown_counter, using only allow-listed commands. Because q holds state, it uses one strategy, sby with engine smtbmc and depth 8, with no sat fallback. The design has 16 states, and q is matched directly, so a small induction depth should suffice. Status: no run result is cited here. The equivalence verdict, the partition count and the named gold and gate files must come from the platform's equivalence.run. Independent review is pending; the upstream design review is [evidence:prj-f735fc7be7.design-under-test.e1]. Limitation: equivalence compares two versions, not either version against the specification, so a bug common to both would not be caught."}], "files": [{"path": "updown_counter.eqy", "kind": "equivalence_setup", "title": "eqy setup: updown_counter gold vs refactor", "summary": "Gold side: [artifact:prj-f735fc7be7.design-under-test.a1] (updown_counter.v). Gate side: [artifact:prj-f735fc7be7.design-under-test.a2] (updown_counter_refactor.v). Each is read with read_verilog and elaborated with prep -top updown_counter. One [strategy] section uses sby with engine smtbmc and depth 8. The setup serves [requirement:req-8077a859ef].", "entry": "updown_counter"}], "tool_runs": [], "claims": ["Both RTL versions appear, from reading their source, to compute the same next-state for q and the same carry/borrow: q ^ chain equals q+1 when up and q-1 when down, and &same equals q==15 when up and q==0 when down. This is a reading of the source, not a proof.", "Depth 8 is expected to be enough for sby k-induction on the q partition; this has not been tested."], "escalation": null, "notes": "The setup sits at the top level, beside the approved RTL files, so it reads them by plain name. It does not create files named updown_counter.v or updown_counter_refactor.v. The [gold] and [gate] command lists differ because they read different files. There is no sat strategy, so a weaker proof cannot stand in for the sby proof. Gold q has no initial value, so it starts unknown; eqy treats an unknown gold value as matching any gate value, and both designs reset q to 0 on rst. A reviewer should run a mutation check, for example flipping the borrow condition or the reset value in the gate, to confirm this setup detects such changes. The seat cannot run that check itself."}
=== FILE: updown_counter.eqy ===
[options]
splitnets on

[gold]
read_verilog updown_counter.v
prep -top updown_counter

[gate]
read_verilog updown_counter_refactor.v
prep -top updown_counter

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 8
engine smtbmc
=== END FILE ===

result.detail: The setup sits at the top level, beside the approved RTL files, so it reads them by plain name. It does not create files named updown_counter.v or updown_counter_refactor.v. The [gold] and [gate] command lists differ because they read different files. There is no sat strategy, so a weaker proof cannot stand in for the sby proof. Gold q has no initial value, so it starts unknown; eqy treats an unknown gold value as matching any gate value, and both designs reset q to 0 on rst. A reviewer should run a mutation check, for example flipping the borrow condition or the reset value in the gate, to confirm this setup detects such changes. The seat cannot run that check itself.
